Fix brain-dead muzzle FX + explosion ground assumptions: muzzle flash now a LOCAL first-person effect at the real viewmodel muzzle anchor (getMuzzleWorldPosition via an empty pinned to the baked 'muzzle' anchor) instead of a huge replicated sprite at the camera eye that blinded the shooter; shrunk flash/smoke. Explosion now uses real injected terrainHeight for the ground (shockwave ring gated to near-ground hits; embers/shrapnel skid on the true terrain) instead of assuming ground==blast Y, which floated the ring/bounce plane for tree/wall/creature/airburst hits.

Shoot-house v2 redesign (bigger + more varied per a 6-agent brainstorm): default footprint 88x150 (was 64x100), asymmetric left/right generated from independent sub-seeds (opts.symmetric restores mirror), size/difficulty presets (wired to ?size=/?difficulty=), entry vestibule with spawn, 3-6 rooms/side with non-uniform depths, six room types (open/cover/pillars/shelving/crates/tables) + L-return cover, staggered spine doorways, chest-high murder-hole windows, mezzanines in deep open rooms, up to two staircases, per-room colored/dim point lights, and emissive exit/hazard signage. Rewrote the Node test suite (552 checks incl. flood-fill reachability, replacing the mirror-symmetry invariant).

Fix wall-bullet collision: shots were resolved against the bilinear terrain heightfield, which stores wall-top height per column and ramps it into adjacent floor cells — spawning invisible shot-blockers ~0.6-1m beside every wall and inside doorways (impacts off the visible wall face; hard to shoot through doorways). Added mapCollider.raycast(origin,dir,maxDist) BVH occluder; resolveHitscan now takes an occluder; resolveWorldShot uses it (hitscan+projectiles) and skips the heightfield march when NO_ENVIRONMENT. Walls/barricades/pillars now stop bullets on their real faces and doorways pass cleanly; cover is ballistic.

Add Node harness verifying the wall-bullet fix without a GPU (ray-vs-box == map-BVH nearest hit): asserts spine doorways clear at y=0.5-2.0 and wall shots land on the real face within T/2 across 5 seeds x 2 sides; reproduces the old heightfield's off-face aliased blocker for contrast.

Fix port-creature wander drifting to world origin: added pure self-relative pickRoamTarget (anti-backtrack cone + optional world bounds, unit-tested) in creature-interaction.js, routed all roamTarget picks through it in port-creature-system.js, and deleted the uncapped origin-anchored boundary force (ARENA_R/SOFT_EDGE/BOUNDARY_GAIN); wired a new getWorldBounds callback through the bridge so authored maps still contain roam while infinite terrain roams freely; removed the leftover window.__pc debug hook.

Make the procedural night sky vary: build() previously seeded its three deterministic generators (stars/Milky Way/bodies) from hardcoded constants, so every load rendered the identical sky. Now all three derive from one palette.seed via XOR salts; added skyRef.setSeed(n) (rebuilds, safe as a discrete call) and persisted starCount/milkyWayIntensity into the palette so a seed rebuild keeps live-adjusted state. SKY_PARAMS.seed is randomized per load and exposed as a Sky-panel number field + Reroll button. sky-field.js untouched (Node tests unaffected).

Phase 2: wire the pure creature-activity.js FSM into port-creature-system.js -- ROLE_WILD creatures now autonomously wander/sleep/hunt/socialize/graze (updateActivity pass, new hunt steering branch, updateCombat huntTarget hookup, wake-on-damage, restPose settle in the render crouch), gated so ambient wildlife always runs it and other wild creatures only under the default wander Mode; pets/hostiles/other Modes unchanged.

Fix sky-reroll 'buffer used in submit while destroyed' freeze: setSeed's rebuild() was the first runtime caller of disposeTree, which called geometry.dispose() on the old sun/moon/celestial-body THREE.Sprites — but all Sprites share one module-level QuadGeometry, so it destroyed the buffer the newly-built sprites still draw from. Freeze only appeared looking up (sprites are frustumCulled). disposeTree now skips geometry disposal for sprites (!o.isSprite).

Expose more sky sliders. Live (uniform/draw-range, no rebuild): star brightness (setStarOpacity) + star color picker (setStarColor). Regeneration (edit SKY_PARAMS, committed by an Apply button / Reroll via setPalette, not live-dragged): planet count + moon count (palette count overrides that still consume their RNG draw), planet/moon size (bodyScale multiplier), planet texture resolution (resScale threaded into celestial-bodies painter canvas edge, clamped 96-2048), and Milky Way density (band points per star). Regeneration rows are slider + number field. Added sky-field test coverage for the count/scale/density overrides. Star point size stays unexposed (WebGPU Points are 1px).
Double default cloud extent (layer1 2000->4000, layer2 4000->8000) and raise both Extent slider maxes to 16000 to push the visible plane edge out; world-space noise sampling means no stretching.

Phase 0 of the internetcore redesign: turn the single Shoot House start-screen card into a type dropdown (SHOOTHOUSE_TYPES) and add a demo room. Builder dispatches on type and reads MATERIALS; viewer threads shoot-house-<type> mapKey and applies bloom/tone defaults under NO_ENVIRONMENT. 26-check Node test added; existing layout+collision tests still green.

Phase 3 of wild-behavior overhaul: per-creature personality. creature-activity.js adds TEMPERAMENTS (6 archetypes: balanced/predator/sleepy/social/grazer/restless) + sampleTemperament(rand,jitter) returning {name,weights} with +/-15% per-weight jitter. variedCreatureConfig seeds config.temperament from its RNG; Creature ctor stores this.temperament/temperamentName; updateActivity passes weights:this.temperament to chooseActivity so activity odds now vary by creature. temperament round-trips through creatureToConfig/creatureToSharedConfig (survives resets/export/MP). Uniform mode stays balanced by design. New sampleTemperament + predator-vs-sleepy bias tests green.

Stage 1 of an in-viewer creature stats/analysis UI. Browser QA of live wiring pending.

Demo-room look tuning (batched from live iteration): grid emissiveIntensity kept 2.6, neon lowered to 1.3; instead dialed the NO_ENVIRONMENT bloom way down (strength/radius 0.05, threshold 1.85, smooth 0.085) so the neon-heavy look reads without blowing out. Also set FPS default walk speed (fp.speedStand) 2.05->4.0 (run stays walk*2.05 ~=8.2).

Phase 2 of the internetcore redesign: the CQB cover vocabulary. New shoot-house-pieces.js exports 5 pure composable pieces (holoBarrier, lightPillar, halfWallBaffle, holoPlatform, portalDoor + PIECES registry), each returning shoot-house-style.js-keyed boxes with a dark body + emissive accent and an `accent` override for phase-3 two-tone zoning; decoupled from the layout module (pre-derived body-scale defaults) to avoid an import cycle. Collision consumes all boxes regardless of kind, so pieces are solid+ballistic automatically. New 22-check pieces test; demo test extended to 30 (asserts baffle/pillar/platform/ramp). Added style+pieces nodes/edges to code-map (style module was missing since phase 0).

Disable scene fog on cloud material (mat.fog=false); worldFog.far is pinned to terrain size so fog was clamping clouds to the map edge regardless of extent - clouds have their own horizon fade.
Fix setExtent one-axis bug: mesh is rotated flat so plane spans local X/Y; scale.set(s,s,1) not (s,1,s) which only grew world X and left world Z pinned at 2000.

summary: Combat bot polish pass from playtesting feedback: fixed a facing bug where the wire-pose quaternion was pi off from the bots own yaw/aim/fire convention so their mesh faced backwards; added pairwise bot/player capsule collision (pushBotsApart) so bots stop phasing into each other and the player; gave GhostRenderers capsule-ghost path a fall-over death pose driven by an alive flag; made respawn (on/off), weapon type (hitscan select), and health/speed/sight-range/seek-tenacity panel-tunable; and replaced the terrain wander fallback with an on-demand local A* window (requestBotPath), since a static full-map bake is infeasible at the 1200-4000m scale of the authored terrain maps.

Added scroll-wheel zoom for the third-person chase cam (lbCamDist state clamped 1.8-9 replacing the hardcoded 3.6 pull-back distance) so WASD-plus-zoom 3rd-person controls work end to end; WASD/mouse-look already worked in third-person since they share the FPS movement pipeline.

Second combat-bot polish pass: GhostRenderer death fall now animates smoothly over 450ms (tick()-driven lerp/slerp) instead of snapping; added a host-local player immortality toggle gating applyHitDamage/applyExplosionBlast; bots now react to being shot or shot-at by turning to face and advance on the threat (reusing the SEEK/tenacity machinery via a new alertBotsToShot near-miss check) and propagate that awareness to nearby squadmates within 15m; and the local player is only perceivable/hittable by bots while actually first-person (fpsMode without third-person body view), fixing a bug where the player could still be shot while in third-person even though they could not see their own body.
Added WASD ground-plane panning to the orbit/overhead camera mode (updateOrbitPan
column5: shift runs) since it previously only supported drag-rotate and scroll-zoom.

summary: Fixed orbit-to-FPS re-entry teleporting the player back to a stale prior position instead of the spot the orbit camera had drag/WASD-panned to; enterFPS now snaps playerCollider to the current orbit target x/z (except on the very first entry or when resuming from a cursor-free pause).
Fixed third-person shooting being silently dropped: fireGunFromCamera sent camera.position (chase-cam pulled back up to lbCamDist behind the body) as the shot origin
column5: which validateShot MAX_ORIGIN_DRIFT anti-cheat check in combat.js rejected with no client-visible error; now uses playerCollider.end when localBodyThird is true.

summary: Third combat-bot polish pass: bots no longer have effectively unlimited ammo (reloadAmmo used to run instantly on an empty mag; now gated behind a 1800ms BOT_RELOAD_MS timer during which the bot keeps aiming but cannot fire); botHasLineOfSight and the terrain nav walkability test now account for trees/rocks (trunkIndex/dressingIndexRef), reusing the same obstacle-column occlusion pipeline real shots resolve against, so bots can no longer see or path through forest/rocks; and added Notice time and Accuracy sliders so a freshly-spotted target has a reaction-delay grace period before a bot is allowed to fire, and fired shots get random spread at low accuracy instead of always landing exactly on the bots true aim.

Code-review pass on the third ammo/LOS/notice polish pass: botHasLineOfSight's raycast (reuses resolveHitscan+obstacleColumnsAlongRay) was running every frame per bot per candidate, previously only run when a shot was actually fired; pickBotTarget now splits into a cheap always-fresh nearest-candidate pass and a per-bot-throttled (120ms, BOT_LOS_CHECK_INTERVAL_MS) raycast. Also fixed the notice-time clock resetting on a single-frame LOS flicker (rec.targetAcquiredAt nulled instantly on any occlusion) by adding a 400ms grace window (BOT_NOTICE_GRACE_MS, rec.lastVisibleAt) before the clock actually resets.

Design-only spec for squads (5+ bots, leader-follow movement, attack/retreat orders), outposts (2-3 squads + outpost leader, ammo stockpile, capturable flag), and a real ammo economy (death drops, leader-called parachute drop crates, squad ammo pool) to replace bots' currently-nonexistent ammo refill path -- not implemented yet, requested as a follow-up to the ammo-exhaustion issue found in code review.

Added an Esc pause menu (Restart Game / Main Menu) usable from FPS, third-person, and orbit; Escape no longer drops FPS into orbit/spectator on its own (only F does, via a new intentionalOrbitExit flag distinguishing F's deliberate pointer-lock release from Escape/alt-tab/focus-loss in the pointerlockchange listener). Both buttons reload the page (simplest clean reset given the single long-lived module script + live multiplayer socket + WebGPU context); Restart first stashes the current {mapKey,mpRole,roomCode,mpWorldMode,presetName} in sessionStorage so start-screen.js's showStartScreen(resumeConfig) skips the role/map picker and silently re-enters the same game, while Main Menu clears that and shows the normal picker.

Refined the squad/outpost spec's command-hierarchy section: replaced the flat 50/50 coin-flip decisions (squad leader's loss-triggered retreat, outpost leader overruling a squad leader, outpost leader commanding other squads when one is lost/retreats) with a single per-bot temperament trait (0-1 aggression) that weights all three rolls, added edge-trigger latching so decisions fire once per event instead of re-rolling every tick, and added a retreat speed multiplier for bots following a retreat order.

Extended the squad/outpost spec with a first aid kit economy (bots spawn with 1, use it via an interruptible run-then-channel heal state that finally implements the FSM's long-deferred hp-gated retreat state, drop it on death alongside ammo via a supply_drop entity generalized from ammo_drop, outposts stock a medkitStockpile) and outpost/squad map placement (outposts placed uniformly at random subject to walkability spacing, squads placed via a distance-weighted accept/reject gradient biased toward but not limited to outpost proximity, mirroring plants-placement.js's existing clustering accept/reject pattern).

Implemented Phase 1 of the squad/outpost spec via two parallel Sonnet agents against a fixed contract: squad-activity.js (pure temperament roll, edge-triggered loss-retreat decision, formation geometry, Node-tested) plus environment-viewer.html wiring (Squad record/Map, batch spawn into squads, leader-follow formation movement, retreat speed multiplier, leader succession, a Squads and Outposts panel section). No ammo/medkits/outposts yet (Phases 2-4). Full test-*.mjs suite (77 files) and node --check both verified clean by the orchestrator after integration; interactive browser verification still outstanding.

Fixed a bug found by playtesting Squad Phase 1: requestBotPath silently beelined straight to the raw goal (ignoring walkability) whenever local A* found no route, which squad followers hit constantly chasing a moving formation point and walked themselves down slopes/into depressions alive, looking dead/stuck. Now retargets to the nearest walkable cell instead, only holding position if that also fails, with a pathRetryAt throttle so a genuinely stuck bot does not rebuild the nav grid every tick. Also fixed botTerrainWalkable checking loadedMap-only seaLevel for underwater rejection, leaving open procedural terrain with no water check at all; switched to the unified terrain.waterLevel.

Code-review follow-up on the terrain-trap fix: retargeting requestBotPath to the nearest walkable cell only covers an unreachable goal, not a bad bot position (e.g. pushBotsApart shoving a bot outside findPath start-snap radius), which would retry forever with the same failure regardless of goal. Added pathFailCount plus a bounded escape hatch (BOT_STUCK_ESCAPE_RETRIES = 6, about 3s of throttled failures) that bypasses the nav grid and steers straight for the bots own trusted spawnPos until a normal path succeeds again, so a stuck bot cannot stall permanently.

Fixed botSpawnSlot ignoring index on open terrain (no authored botSpawnPoints), which spawned every member of a squad on the same coincident point and left them visually clumped; fallback now spreads slots via a golden-angle spiral.

Fixed a second, distinct squad-clumping cause found by follow-up user question: retreat order sent every surviving squad member to the literal same squad.spawnPos coordinate instead of a formation-ring offset around it, so an already-active squad that took losses mid-fight would collapse onto one point just like the coincident-spawn bug. Non-leaders now keep their formation offset around the rally point during retreat.

Added a bot inspector debug tool (host/solo only) to diagnose continued live movement glitches directly: Alt+Click a bot in the scene or a table row to select it, arrow keys or Prev/Next buttons cycle, a live panel shows fsm state/position/speed/path-fail-count/squad/ammo, a yellow ring marker highlights the selection in 3D, and a per-row or panel Teleport button jumps the local player to any bot. GhostRenderer gained a playerGroups() accessor for the scene raycast pick.

Fixed a TDZ ReferenceError on hostBroadcastTick: botPlayers was declared with const far below where createHostSession wired getState in as a broadcast callback, so a fast local connection could fire the first tick during an intervening await and crash before botPlayers existed. Moved the declaration up next to mpGuestPlayers, which the same functions already depend on.

Fixed the documented third-person weapon-anchor scale bug: asRoot() in weapon-pose-controller.js now forwards decomposed scale, and composeRoot() in weapon-sequence.js multiplies weapon-anchor local positions by weaponRoot.scale (body/camera refs still skip it, since those offsets are already body-scale units) -- hands were missing the visible grip on weapons with non-unit thirdPersonHold scale (M1911 0.68, M24/Bren/RPG 2). Added scale coverage to test-weapon-sequence.mjs.

Added an http fallback (loadSfxSoundsHttp / loadSfxHttp) so SFX load automatically by fetching sfx/sound-map.json + assets/*.wav from the server, instead of requiring a manual File System Access folder pick every session; restoreSfxFolder() now falls back to it whenever no folder handle is stored or its permission is not silently granted. Root cause of a user report of no gunfire audio: the picker-only path silently no-ops play()/playAt() calls with zero console error when sfxBuffers is empty.

Synced m1911/five_seven/m24/cz_805_bren ADS aim (aimOffset/aimRotation), plus m24 and cz_805_bren scope/optics fields (magnification/scopeBlur/scopeRadius/scopeCenter) and cz_805_bren viewOffset/viewRotation/recoil/aimEyeForward, from the live-tuned values already sitting in a dev browser local session storage -- the committed file had stale pre-tuning defaults that only the hosted deploy (fresh origin, no override) was actually rendering; local looked correct because the browser override was masking the stale file.

Gated the pcw:weaponTuning localStorage save/restore behind a ?tune=1 query flag (TUNE_MODE) -- the mirror had no versioning, so a stale slider override in a browser would silently mask any future weapons.js default fix forever with no way to notice; only explicit ?tune=1 sessions now read/write it.

Add lifetime per-bot combat/movement stats (shots/hits/kills/deaths, time-in-state, distance traveled, stuck detection) to the bot inspector panel and a continuous botStatsLog CSV auto-uploaded to research/stats/bots-*.csv while recording.

Added a standalone menu-music audio hook to start-screen.js (plays the music_menu sound-map.json event during the role/map picker, since environment-audio.js is not constructed until after that screen resolves) and fixed sfx-browser.html hardcoding assets/<eventId>.wav for every assignment regardless of source format -- music tracks are almost never actually wav, so that bug would have silently broken any menu-music assignment.

Added a time-of-day driver (Component 3/C) to environment-viewer.html: static-imports sunPosition/moonPosition from solar-position.js and lerpHex from sky-field.js, adds a Time of day UI section above Lighting (master toggle + hour/latitude/day-of-year/moon-phase/speed + Play/Pause), and applyTimeOfDay() drives rig elevation/azimuth/sun color/sun intensity/ambient plus independent sun+moon sky dirs/visibility and moonLight from real solar geometry each frame while enabled, auto-enabling celestial opacity fade-in on first activation; the manual driver-off path is unchanged.

Fix ReferenceError: params is not defined thrown every animate() frame -- the time-of-day driver read params (todEnabled/todHour/todSpeed/todPlaying) which was a bare const scoped to the forest-loading promise callback, invisible to the top-level animate() function; forward-declared params at module scope like applyTimeOfDay/skyRef and changed the declaration to a plain assignment.

Stopped gameplay from falling back to the music_menu track when no music_game track is assigned -- desiredMusicEvent() now returns silence instead, since the menu track playing through actual gameplay was reported as unwanted, not a missing-fallback bug.

Added a Default/Off/<track> music dropdown to the start-screen role picker, backed by a new serve.py GET /api/list-music endpoint that enumerates sfx/music/ -- ships a standard menu-music selection out of the box (any file dropped in that folder becomes selectable) while the existing sfx-browser.html music_menu assignment remains available as the Default option.

Reworked the start-screen music picker from an auto-playing select dropdown into a scrollable click-to-play/click-to-stop song list, per feedback that music should never start automatically and that a native select does not scale as a song list -- selection is no longer persisted, every visit opens silent until a row is clicked.

Restored menu autoplay on the start screen (Default row starts playing and highlighted as soon as the role/map picker appears) after clarifying that no-autoplay only meant gameplay was falling back to the menu track, not the menu itself; song list still lets the player switch tracks or click Default again to stop it.

Removed the Default/music_menu-event row from the start-screen song list -- it was leftover indirection from before the sfx/music/ folder listing existed and just duplicated whichever track was also assigned via sfx-browser.html. Autoplay now picks the first track straight from /api/list-music instead.

Fixed menu music actually bleeding into loading and gameplay: loadSfxHttp()/loadSfxSounds() (run automatically at startup via restoreSfxFolder) were calling syncMusicForState() right after loading finished, auto-starting the music_menu track for the entire Loading world systems sequence and past it -- envAudio.update()s gameplayActive transition only cut it once real gameplay began. Removed those two automatic calls; envAudio now never autoplays on its own, matching repeated feedback that autoplay should be menu-only (start-screen.js already owns that).

Fix bots falling through the map forever (39% of bots in a recorded session): track rec.lastSafePos and recover onto it on an uncaught fall, and retarget the stuck-escape hatch to lastSafePos instead of spawnPos; also force a repath when stuckMs stays high despite a nominally-valid path so wedged bots eventually escape too.

Added a clickable song list to the in-game Audio tabs Track card (environment-ui.js), replacing the prev/next-only transport with a full state.playlist listing -- exposed playTrack() (playMusicPlaylistEntry) and currentTrackPath on environment-audio.js so a specific track can be selected directly and the active row highlighted, mirroring the start-screen song list per feedback that the list belonged in the in-game panel UI, not only the start screen.

Fixed six sky/cloud rendering artifacts: (1) celestial bodies + sun/moon discs are now camera-oriented plane meshes (createCelestialBodies faceMode:'fixed'; makeDisc) instead of THREE.Sprites, so distant planets no longer appear to rotate as the view yaws -- billboard mode kept as default for stellar-viewer/tests; (2) widened generateStars hemiDir upper bound 0.96->1.0 to fill the bare circular gap at the zenith; (3) restacked sky renderOrder so background stars (-997) sit BEHIND bodies (-996) and discs (-995) instead of twinkling in front of planets; (4) discs+bodies set frustumCulled=false and stableCelestialLayering now defaults ON so small moons stop popping/swapping at the view edge; (5) reworked the cloud horizon fade to be extent-relative with a floored haze + outer-edge cutoff (uHalfExtent uniform; uFade repurposed as a 0..1 edge-dim, default 0.5) so the deck reaches the horizon instead of vanishing within ~1000 units; (6) clouds set depthWrite:false so the transparent plane stops punching holes in tree foliage. Each disc/body owns its own PlaneGeometry so disposeTree stays freeze-safe. Node tests pass (added faceMode:'fixed' coverage to the smoke test).
Redesigned the in-game controls as a right-docked icon-rail inspector with routed compact accordions, responsive bottom-sheet behavior, and non-blocking control feedback.
Moved the floating creature command summary into the Procedural Creatures inspector and hardened panel containment to prevent population-label overlap and collapsed-dock coverage.
Raised the inspector icon rail above panel content and removed dock clipping from its hover tooltips.
Started the inspector collapsed and added a persistent left-edge resize nub for the open desktop dock.
Removed the arbitrary inspector resize cap; the open dock can now use the full available viewport width.
Added a persistent Theme inspector destination with component color editing, palette maps, opacity controls, and brush-cursor paint selection for settings, maps, and the health/ammo HUD.
Consumed Theme paint-mode pointer and click events so selecting a recolor target cannot trigger its underlying UI action.
Made Theme paint targets persist as outlined color-editor selections after paint mode ends and limited paint-mode editing to the color controls.
Moved Theme paint target selection to right-click so normal left-click interactions continue to work while paint mode is active.

Fix the stuck-force-replan fix from the previous entry not actually working: a follow-up botStatsLog recording showed zero fall-throughs (good) but still 25s+ frozen bots, because the forced pathFailCount bump was reset next tick by a nominally-successful repath against the same physically-blocked goal. Added a separate stuckReplanCount that only clears on real movement or escape-hatch arrival, so wedged bots now reach BOT_STUCK_ESCAPE_RETRIES too.

Read-only systemic review of bot stuck-ness: CSV re-analysis shows stalls are absorbing (no episode >1s ever recovered), the lastSafePos escape hatch is a no-op for grounded bots, and the new stuckReplanCount branch is unreachable for wedged bots; recommends recovery retarget, nav-grid erosion, unified movement status, displacement-based stuck metric, and separation steering.

Implement R1+R4 from the Fable systemic-stuck review (docs/superpowers/reviews/2026-07-18-bot-stuck-systemic-review.md): both prior stuck-recovery fixes were confirmed broken in the exact cases they targeted (escape hatch steered to a target that always equaled the bots own position; stuckReplanCount fed a branch that could never run). Recovery now targets the nearest walkable cell to the bots own position via new botNearestWalkableToBot(), the escape check runs unconditionally instead of gated behind an empty path, and the stuck diagnostic is fed real displacement instead of commanded velocity so bot-vs-bot blocking is no longer invisible to it.

Fable re-review of the R1+R4 diff found one more self-cancellation bug before it shipped: a stuckReplanCount-triggered escape episode aborted after a single tick because moving toward the escape target itself cleared stuckSince, which reset stuckReplanCount, which dropped the trigger condition. Fixed by adding rec.escapeTarget itself to the trigger so an in-progress episode persists until arrival or timeout regardless of counter resets.

Bake-once botMeshBlockedAt cache tests nav cells against the real collision mesh (mapCollider.resolveCapsule) instead of only the aliasable height/trunk/dressing checks, fixing bots pathing through cliffs/rock formations on open terrain that terrainHeight could miss; result cached forever per cell so the BVH is only ever queried once per unique location.
Senior review of bot-port investigation: verified all five agent docs; identified weapon-rig absolute-Y flat-floor bug as Bug #1 root cause; wrote phased fix/perf plan.

Bot-port Phase 1: fixed invisible bot arms/weapon (rig Y now terrain-relative terrainHeight+1.5 instead of the flat-floor absolute 1.5 that buried the gun and both arm IK targets underground on real terrain); shared the local player's weapon-model template cache + skeletonClone per bot instead of an uncached per-bot GLTF load (no longer disposes shared geometry/materials on death); added 800ms retry backoff on failed mount build; added mount-state readout to the Bot Inspector.
Reviewed Phase 1 bot-weapon impl (approve w/ 2 must-fixes: shared-template dispose in teardownLocalWeaponMount
column5: retry-arm race); revised plan for locked decisions (unbounded bots=>Phase 4 mandatory
column6: per-bot color).

summary: Bot-port Phase 1.5 (Fable review must-fixes): teardownLocalWeaponMount no longer disposes weapon geometry now shared via lbWeaponModelCache with all bot clones (a local weapon switch was freeing GPU buffers out from under live bots); bot mount retry backoff now only arms when the request is still current so a late stale bail can't re-throttle after a newer success.

Replaced the leash-radius random wander with directional exploration (fixed heading, 80-300m hops, 50m exclusion history) for unsquadded/leader bots, widened squad ring to 8m, and added an auto-switching single-file formation for narrow corridors plus a manual Ring/Column/Auto panel toggle.

Bot-port Phase 2 perf: module-scope shared body-geometry cache (one BufferGeometry per shape+dims across all bodies; destroy() skips userData.shared) cutting ~31 tessellations+GPU buffers per bot to a fixed set; bots-only render LOD in GhostRenderer (distance tiers 45/100/240m: full/2nd/4th-frame stride staggered per bot, hidden past 240m; humans/local exempt) plus matching held-weapon-mount LOD with dt accumulation; hoisted per-frame leg/arm Vector3 allocs and loop-invariant idle-arm offsets out of the body update hot loop. Materials kept per-body for per-bot color.

Phase 4 bot-port perf: instanced bot-body render pool (new body-part-batches.js) with per-instance color; player-procedural-body gains a batches/flush mode (bots only local+humans keep mesh path); GhostRenderer instanceBots option + per-bot botBodyStyle color; collapses ~31 draw-calls/bot to ~1 per part type. Headless tests green browser QA pending.

Added weapon GLB compression pipeline (Draco geometry + WebP textures, ported from research/glb-shrink-main.zip) as a local glb-shrink-server Node service with a versioned original/run archive under models/guns/.glb-shrink/, wired into a new weapon-viewer-v2.html Compress panel (presets, quality slider, restorable history) and server-tool.py/.html as a third managed process.

Fixed a regression from the weapon-compression feature: no GLTFLoader in the repo had a DRACOLoader attached, so any Draco-compressed weapon glb (e.g. low-poly_cz_805_bren.glb, compressed via the new panel) failed to load everywhere weapons are rendered. Added shared draco-loader.js (attachDracoLoader) and wired it into every weapon-model GLTFLoader: environment-viewer.html (3), bot-viewer.html, both weapon anchor editors, and all three body-preview viewers.

Fixed selectBotTarget passing Vector3s to mapCollider.raycast (which reads array indices), making the occlusion filter a NaN-ray no-op: bots always targeted the nearest enemy even through walls instead of preferring the nearest visible one.

Perf: weapon GLBs now load once into botWeaponTemplateCache and mounts clone(true) shared geometry/materials (destroy no longer disposes); weapon meshes frustum-cull normally again (removed frustumCulled=false); overhead point light no longer casts shadow (was 6 cube-face passes/frame over uncullable weapon meshes).

Perf: replaced forced full-subtree updateMatrixWorld(true) walks with ancestor-only updateWorldMatrix(true,false) in worldTransformOf/updateBotWeaponMount/alignMountedWeaponToPoint (cost scaled with weapon GLB node count per bot per frame) and reuse scratch Vector3/Quaternion/Euler in the controller hot path; behavior and public API unchanged.

Perf: bot-viewer procedural bodies now render through the shared body-part-batches instanced pool (lazily created, beginFrame/flush-per-actor/endFrame around updateAllBots) instead of ~30 meshes + 4 materials per bot; documented the whole pass in bots.md.

Fixed floating detached guns from the perf pass: weapon template clones now use SkeletonUtils.clone (plain clone(true) left skinned GLBs bound to the template's bones, stacking every bot's rifle at the bind pose) and weapon meshes keep frustumCulled=false like environment-viewer's mounts since skinned meshes cull by bind-pose bounds.
Calibration now recomputes when the pelvis-height slider drifts post-bake and refuses to bake orientation corrections while the driver is moving.

Restore negated foot-forward sign in getV3TerrainFootFrame (round-2 agent rewrite had reverted the round-1 fix; feet pointed backward ever since — found by snapshot bisection).

Add pursue<->aim hysteresis (pursueExitBuffer
column5: mirrors flee buffer) and make healUnsafe dominate healReady in chooseBotState so contradictory heal signals cannot thrash HEAL<->FLEE; regression tests added.

summary: Add standalone pure Verlet ragdoll solver (16-particle humanoid; proportions from player-procedural-body.js) plus a WebGPU tuning viewer (drop/punch/blast + live physics sliders); first step toward replacing GhostRenderer's rigid death-pose tip-over. Node-tested (18 checks); browser QA pending.

Ragdoll step A: add setRagdollPose (poses the rig from 16 ragdoll joints via placeSegment; mesh+instanced) and seedRagdollFromJoints; ragdoll-viewer gains a real-body flop demo (Spawn body -> Kill) validating the body<->ragdoll mapping before the GhostRenderer death-edge wiring (step B).

summary: Widen maze corridors: bump MAZE_CELL 2.5->3.5 (clear hall width 2.2->3.2 units); walls/nav-grid/spawns/camera all derive from it.
Make maze hall width a live slider (1.5-6m clear) instead of a fixed constant: MAZE_CELL->mutable mazeCellSize; hallWidthRow range control rebuilds the active maze on input.

Pursue-on-miss: bots fire on sight at any distance; PURSUE only when healthy (>60% HP) AND keeps missing (missStreak>=3); lost-sight SEEK now health-gated too. New chooseBotState ctx keepsMissing/pursueHealthOk (defaults keep env-viewer working pre-rewrite).

Expose maze design as live controls: rectangular cols/rows, mutable WALL_T/WALL_H sliders, continuous loop-chance (replaces discrete style presets), straightness DFS bias, braid dead-end removal, and a mulberry32 seed (number field + reroll button; Test condition pinned to 1337) for reproducible mazes.

summary: Add bot FOV: horizontal vision cone (withinBotFov) centered on bot.yaw gates both target acquisition (selectBotTarget) and sustained visibility (sentry) so out-of-cone enemies fall into a blind spot; live 'Field of view (deg)' slider 1-360 (default 360 = omnidirectional, prior behavior).

Add high-payoff maze structure controls: open-room injection (merge NxN cell blocks into arenas), scattered partial-height cover pieces (blocks nav via activeCovers but rendered short so LOS/shot raycasts pass over -> real cover), perimeter entrances onto a walkable apron for flanking, and a start/goal placement dropdown (corners/center/random via seed-offset RNG); Test condition resets them to defaults.
Change default bot FOV from 360 to 120 degrees (forward cone with rear/side blind spot); slider range unchanged.
Ragdoll death per-weapon + per-body-part: weaponKnockback(weapon) (explicit field or derive from damage/mode) sets base knockback; applyDeathImpulse now takes {dir

summary: Add 'FOV wedge' toggle: per-bot ground-plane sector mesh (buildFovWedgeGeometry, triangle fan spanning fovDegrees, rotated to bot.yaw, scaled to sightDistance) rendered under the sight ring; geometry rebuilds when the FOV slider changes; off by default.

Link engagement distance to weapon range: botWeaponStandoff maps weapon.range*standoffFactor (clamped inside sight) to a preferred standoff used as both the pursue/fire-band threshold and the pursuit movement goal; kite/flee trigger = half the standoff. Long-range guns (m24) hold ~20m and back off sooner; pistols fight at ~6m.

Consumable health packs: bots heal by spending charge from packs (spawn w/ 1 full, cap 2, drop remaining on death, loot off ground); pure charge/inventory math + tests in new bot-health-packs.js; FSM HEAL now gated by hasHealResource; viewer adds crouch-on-heal, in-hand pack visual, world pickups w/ opportunistic collect + wounded/healthy seek, and a QA drop-pack button.

Add live sliders for the pursue/standoff tuning knobs: standoffFactor, fleeStandoffFraction (new; replaces hardcoded 0.5 kite trigger), pursueMissStreak, pursueHealthThreshold01. Fixed createBotBehaviorSlider to show step-derived decimals so sub-0.1 factors read correctly.

Health-pack pickup now triggers a brief crouch dip: collectPacksUnderfoot stamps actor.packPickupCrouchUntil (botPackSettings.pickupCrouchMs, 450ms) and updateBot folds it into the rig crouch channel.

findPath rewritten with a binary-heap open set + typed-array g-scores (was linear-scan Map, ms-per-call at maze scale); added floodFill/floodPath bounded-Dijkstra exports so callers can score many candidate goals from one pass.

Gunfight lag fix: findFleeGoal now scores candidates from one bounded floodFill instead of one A* per ring cell (measured 100-830ms/call on maze maps, now <1ms) with healing cover raycasts capped to the 24 best; pooled tracer/bullet/hit-impact FX (visible toggling, no per-shot geometry/material creation); per-shot DOM and state-record textarea flush once per frame, record log append-only.

Healing bots now play a medic pose: gun holstered (weaponRig hidden), pack held in left hand on the left knee, right hand dabbing between pack and chest via body.setArmTarget; updateHealPose replaces the weapon mount during BOT_HEAL, endHealPose restores it on exit (edge-detected by actor.wasHealing).

Instanced held-weapon rendering: new weapon-part-batches pool (bucket per sub-mesh geometry, template GLB materials); bot mounts drop the per-bot SkeletonUtils.clone and flush weaponView x baked sub-mesh matrices per frame, so N same-weapon bots cost one draw set per weapon type; skinned guns instanced rigid (skeletons never animated).

Fix instanced skinned guns rendering rotated out of the hands: authored node pose != skinned pose, so new bakeSkinnedGeometry freezes the never-animated bone pose into static geometry at template load (positions+normals, per-vertex blend, verified exact vs three applyBoneTransform).

Add a modular role system + first role (medic). New pure bot-roles.js (role registry, batch assignment, leadership/pickSquadLeader seam for the coming squad system) and bot-medic.js (heal/revive/cohesion decisions); bot-health-packs gains per-holder capacity + revive-kit fusing. Medics carry 4 packs, a sidearm, and a cross insignia; they break off to heal wounded allies and revive recently-killed ones (rebuilds body/ragdoll), fire-while-tend with a one-handed medicHold pose, and regroup via team cohesion when idle. Spawn frequency via a medic-% toolbar input + Spawn-medic button. Node-tested; browser QA pending.
Plan for baked cell-pair visibility field + corner cover map + BOT_COVER FSM states (peek/hold), plus retrofitting flee/heal cover scoring and muzzle recovery onto the baked field.

Fix bots pinning against walls while seeking a health pack: dropped/test packs could land on non-walkable cells, so a seeker paths to the nearest reachable cell and presses into the wall trying to reach an uncollectable pickup radius. spawnWorldHealthPack now snaps every pack to the nearest walkable nav cell (snapToWalkable).
Bot-bot pushout + separation steering + goal-claim store so bots can't overlap, phase through each other, or commit to the same goal cell.
Baked pairwise cell-visibility bitfield + corner cover map (anchors/peek points off sight-blocker rects); nearestWalkable exported for reuse.
BOT_COVER_MOVE/HOLD FSM states with corner pick via visibility bit tests, ally-hit trigger, and peek/conceal fight cycle from cover anchors.
Retrofit flee cover scoring (all candidates all flees; raycast cap deleted), muzzle recovery, and flagged LOS prefilter onto the baked visibility field.
Document the visibility field / corner cover / separation systems and mark the plan implemented pending browser QA.

Fix medic cohesion clumping: cohesionTarget now averages only the LOCAL group (teammates within cohesionNeighborRadius) instead of the global team centroid (which parked medics at the empty midpoint between two separated groups), falling back to the nearest teammate when none are in perception; viewer excludes fellow medics from the snapshot so support anchors on the fighting line rather than pair-bonding.
Fix hallway corner jams: lineWalkable now supercover DDA (string-pull can't emit through-wall segments), separation blend gated by walkability probe, contested-waypoint reach relax.

Explosion ragdolls: add reusable applyBlastImpulse (radial launch + upward pop) and a minimal harness explosion in bot-viewer (projectile weapons detonate at hitscan impact via detonateBlast: radial damage falloff
column5: blast-killed bots ragdoll outward
column6: pooled sphere-flash FX). Tests: test-ragdoll-body 14 checks.

summary: Bots now hold position for a servicing medic: the medic leases a short heal-hold (healHoldUntil/healMedicXZ) on its heal target once within healHoldRadius or tending; the ally's sentry stops its locomotion states (patrol/seek/pursue/flee) to wait (still aims/fires, faces the medic) and the lease auto-expires when the medic leaves. Medic topping an ally to resume01 also clears the ally's own heal-retreat latch.

QA fixes: re-path when bot-to-waypoint segment goes illegal (off-path shove freeze), cover re-pick hysteresis (0.35s invalid grace + 0.8s switch cooldown vs 599-switch/10s thrash), weapon-range gate + 6-shot peek miss-streak so bots can't camp cover plinking forever.

Fix frozen cover/aim campers: all exits advanced only on shots fired, so dry-mag bots and stale-ghost threats held forever; added fire-drought (6s) and threat-stale (5.5s) hold exits, fireCapable/knifeCapable ladder inputs (dry bots flee or knife-charge, knife 8m gate removed), and a self-healing cover-state invariant.
Fix per-kill TypeError in fireBotKnife: killing blow nulls global botTarget mid-call; local victim capture (exposed by dry bots now knife-charging).

Stop medics clustering: decideMedicDuty now excludes fellow medics from heal candidates (medic-on-medic healing made them converge and could mutual-heal-deadlock; medics self-heal from their own packs) and adds a per-patient claim lease (medicClaimBy/medicClaimUntil) so medics spread across the wounded instead of piling on one. Fallen medics remain valid revive targets.

Fix isolated medics clumping with no patients around: cohesionTarget's across-map 'nearest teammate' fallback made every isolated medic home on the same far fighter and funnel into one clump at a chokepoint. Removed the fallback -- cohesion now pulls only toward a LOCAL group (teammates within perception); with none nearby the medic returns null and patrols/scatters instead.

Make medic ally/corpse selection wall-aware: it was pure straight-line distance, so a medic detected allies through walls (picking a wall-adjacent one over a same-room one, or committing to an unreachable ally and pinning on the wall). Now attachMedicNavCost tags each candidate with a nav path distance from one bounded flood-fill (Euclidean prefilter, throttled recompute), the pure selectors rank/gate by that cost, unreachable candidates are dropped, and MEDIC_TEND/heal-hold use path distance so a medic won't tend through a wall. Euclidean fallback with no nav grid.
Squad-alert lemming fix: lethal-weighted ally-hit windows, band-free cover entry on ally reports, concealed alert-hold (capped) so bots stop patrolling into fresh kill zones.

Corner-jam round 2 (harness-verified, first attempt discarded as regression): contested-relax pop gated on successor legality, damped separation reversal, margin-band path recovery, patrol anti-stall give-up.
Overhead yellow exclamation mark on any bot whose squad alert (latestAllyHitNear) is actionable, so alert triggering can be verified visually before extending triggers.
Alert hold unconditional: exposed patrollers now pause and face the reported threat too (concealment gate removed per QA); hold cap 10s->20s as pure freeze backstop.
Flipped bot-viewer panel defaults: procedural body now On by default, tactical nav debug now Off by default.
Auto-add bots panel: spawn N bots per targeted team (Both/Alpha/Bravo) every X seconds via updateBotAutoAdd in the animation loop; first wave fires immediately on enable.

Semi-alert propagation: secondhand alerts spread one hop from alerted teammates, response tiered by escalation score (wary pause / defensive hold-cover / group-backed push); orange vs yellow ! markers.
Auto-add now honors medic% via per-team fractional accumulator (botAutoAddMedicAccum) so small waves still spawn medics at the set rate instead of rounding to 0.
Alert marker now shows the escalation score as a tinted digit beside the ! so wary/defensive/push tiers are visually distinct.

Blast damage now calls recordAllyHit (and recordBotDamage) with the thrower, so grenade/RPG casualties raise squad alerts like bullets; victim loop split so kills still ragdoll radially via blastFrom.
Near-miss shots now alert the bot they whistled past (1.5 m radius, 1.5 s window, zero escalation weight, firsthand-only, cyan ! marker, hold+orient response).

Alert response unified onto the escalation score (source-blind wary/defensive/push, firsthand can now push, firsthand graze downgraded to wary flinch); marker palette reworked: red saw-it, yellow heard-it, green push, cyan near miss.

Split attention: alerted bots now alternate between the threat bearing and their travel heading (and sweep while standing) instead of pinning yaw, so the FOV cone stops blinding them to enemies from other directions.

9-agent perf audit of bot-viewer at high bot counts: hand-verified findings (O(N^2) LOS raycasts; no bot spatial hash; full-grid A* allocs; replan storms; full-capacity instance uploads; immortal corpses) + 5-phase remediation plan

Squad membership was decided only at spawn, so attrition left teams as unmergeable two-man remnants; added a continuous reconciler (pure planSquadReconcile emitting split/mergeDetachments/merge/absorb ops) with detachments for over-strength squads, seniority-based merge leadership and a named line of succession.

Bots spawned at random walkable cells, so reinforcements often appeared across the map from their squad; spawn placement now resolves squad-anchor then team side then anywhere, with a new side mode (teamSideRegions splits the map long-axis) and separately-togglable home base compounds (generateHomeBase emits ordinary walls/covers so they hit the collider and nav bake).

Squads treated medics as ordinary rifles: id-ordered ranks put them on the wedge point, bounding overwatch handed them maneuver bounds, and triage was pure proximity so they abandoned their own squad; added a role support flag driving formationRanks (support at the back), a base-element pin in applyPushElement, and an own-squad ranking bias in bot-medic that never touches response/tend range.

Label connected components at nav-grid bake (regions/regionSizes/mainRegion, A*'s own corner rule) and early-out findPath on a cross-region goal: reachability becomes an O(1) lookup instead of A*'s worst case, which expands every reachable cell before returning null (0.6ms -> 0.001ms, re-run every 300ms per stuck bot).

Guarantee the walkable ground is one piece: erosion channels and landform faces were fencing off up to 711 m2 per map, and a bot spawned there stood still because every goal handler zeroes velocity on an empty path. connectGrid labels components, routes the thinnest part of each barrier and carves a graded pass; verified by re-labelling rather than assumed.

Passes must cut AND fill. The strandings that survived every round were ringed by a one-cell erosion gully, not a ridge - lowering a hole does nothing, so those routes were carved to no effect. Filling capped at 1.5m above the lower end so a long route cannot pave a ravine into a causeway; convergence went from 3-6 rounds with strandings left to 1-2 rounds with none.

Pass rims taper in proportion to cut depth and stay under the walk limit: a fixed half-metre taper turned a 3m cut into a wall of its own, and the sliver pinched between it and the old hillside was a fresh stranding the next round had to chase. Also skip labelling entirely when no cell inside bounds is blocked, so a fully walkable map pays 0.3ms instead of 4ms.

Spawn fallback now requires the main nav region ('anywhere walkable' has to mean anywhere the rest of the map can reach), patrol skips points in another region instead of standing still between re-plans, and reportNavRegions warns once per layout when walkable ground is still cut off - walls and cover can fence a region off where no terrain pass can help.
Documented the bots-standing-in-valleys fix: what the symptom actually was, the three approaches that failed on measurement (grading to the limit, steep rims, lowering-only), and the cost either way.

Stance capsule height is now measured off the procedural rig (stanceCapsuleHeightScale) instead of two guessed constants that were 10% and ~50% wrong and ignored the speed-adaptive pelvis ratio; pose and capsule share one eased crouch/prone weight so silhouette and hitbox cannot diverge, which let heightEnabled ship on by default.

Prone was unreachable: the gate read remaining hold lease (a 500 ms window re-granted every frame) against a 1200 ms bar, so it could never clear; now gated on elapsed held time via a holdSince stamp that resets when a hold lapses.

Swept bot-viewer-v2 with 12 Sonnet finder agents + 12 Opus verifiers: 22 unique inefficiency findings (17 confirmed, 5 partial, 0 refuted), 16 fixes revised for aliasing/correctness hazards; biggest items are per-drag-tick full map rebuilds and updateHostPlayerGhosts running N+1 times per frame in firefights.

Deleted the dead measureMountedShotAlignment per-shot diagnostic (5 Vector3s + a redundant world-matrix walk per shot feeding lastShotAlignment, which nothing read) plus its orphaned helpers; v1 bot-viewer.html keeps its own live copies.

Host ghost pass no longer runs N+1 times per frame in firefights: the seven mid-frame updateHostPlayerGhosts call sites (per-shot applyCombatIntent, guest join/leave, bot spawn/despawn, host sync) now set hostGhostsDirty, flushed once at the end of updateBots before weapon mounts read the bodies it drives.

floodFill now reuses pooled full-grid dist/parent buffers with a deferred Chebyshev band-clear instead of allocating+zeroing ~0.5MB per call; retaining callers (medicNavFlood in both viewers, which hold results 200ms across actors) pass per-actor out buffers so pool reuse cannot alias one medic distances onto another.

Auto-add waves now respect population caps (max/team default 30, max total default 50) via number inputs beside the wave controls: each wave clamps to remaining living-bot headroom (partial batches allowed, emptier team served first), medic accumulator charges the spawned count, toggle reads 'On (at cap)' when a wave spawns nothing; caps persist in the save slots.
Author camera redesign plan: replace the four-mode two-authority camera with one stored intent struct and one writer per frame, collapsing orbit/follow/POV/fly into anchor x distance axes.

Added a ?prof=1 per-phase frame profiler to bot-viewer-v2 (reusing frame-profiler.js, window.__botProf hook) and a Document-Policy: js-profiling header to serve.py; measured 90-bot firefight at ~21fps with sim 18-21ms vs render 6-10ms, establishing the bot sim (not the GPU) as the high-bot-count fps ceiling.

Added ?autoprofile=1 self-profiling mode (spawns a fight, samples phases + JS stack trace, uploads results to research/stats/ via /api/save-stats) after remote tab control proved unreliable; clean 90-bot capture shows ~37fps early-fight with sim 12ms spread across sentry FSM/rig+pose/physics/alert scans and render CPU 4-5ms of scene-graph overhead.

Staggered bot thinking: updateBotSentry now runs every Nth frame per spawn-order cohort with banked dt (auto stride by living count, focused bot exempt, panel button + ?stagger= override); A/B autoprofile at 90 bots shows sim 10-12ms -> 8-9ms and 42.4 -> 45.1 avg fps, leaving per-frame updateBot (physics+rig) as the next target.

Camera redesign: replaced the four-mode two-authority camera with one stored intent struct (bot-camera.js, pure + Node-tested) and a single per-frame writer; dropped OrbitControls for one pointer path with pointer lock, collapsed the modes into anchor/distance/drive axes with continuous zoom into first person, made occlusion a transient distance ceiling, symmetric +-85 pitch, unclamped stored zoom, POV auto-recenter off by default. Landed in a forked bot-viewer-v2-camera.html because another session was editing bot-viewer-v2.html.

Rig LOD: bots beyond 18m/45m re-solve procedural body + weapon pose every 2nd/4th frame with banked dt (camera subject exempt, physics/hitboxes untouched, Rig LOD button + ?riglod=0); maze A/B at 90 bots cut sim ~40% (fps 31.7->34.5); autoprofile gained &proflayout=maze and &profclose=1, and the maze runs exposed render submit at 13-25ms/frame from ~950 per-wall meshes as the dominant maze cost.
Instanced maze walls/covers (one InstancedMesh per material + instance expansion in createMapCollider); maze 90-bot render submit 13-25ms -> 3.7-5.3ms and avg fps 34.5 -> 51.9

Sidearms: every bot carries a pistol behind its primary and draws it (550ms) instead of reloading while under fire, swapping back in a lull; entity.weapon now means the gun in hand so ammo/standoff/SFX follow the swap, knife demoted to third-tier (both guns dry), plus stowed back/hip visuals rendered from the held-gun instancing pool with a reduced part list

Locomotion weapon carries: new shared (stance x locomotion) hold resolver -- continuous stance lerp on the rig's own eased weights plus an additive per-class walk/run/dash delta -- fixes v2 ignoring crouchHold/proneHold entirely, adds muzzle-down walk/run and a one-handed muzzle-up dash gated off the barrel solve; STANCE_DASH added to bot-stance (no exit cost, fastest, worst spread) and triggered by grenade evade via a self-expiring evadingUntil stamp; weapon-animation-viewer gains a Carry authoring panel and now mounts torso-relative at visualYaw+headYaw like v2 (it previewed every hold 180deg off); mount Y offset now captured only while upright

Sniper + technical roles as pure descriptors: role gains sidearm/sightScale/bonusGrenades/swapOnDryMag/closeRange (defaulted via ROLE_DEFAULTS) so no viewer code branches on a role id -- sniper carries m24+pistol at 1.5x sight (one botSightDistanceFor accessor now feeds acquisition, LOS, pack scan, standoff clamp and the tactical rings) and, being bolt-action, swaps on a rusher inside 14m rather than on its permanently-dry mag; technical carries rpg backed by a cz_805_bren so each rocket reload is spent shooting, with closeRange 10 keeping it outside its own 8.2m blast, plus one extra grenade; assignRolesToBatch takes a role mix that never overwrites another role's slot, wired to sniper%/technical% inputs, spawn buttons, squad templates, per-role auto-add debt and the save slots

Live grenade ordnance sliders (explode delay, delay randomness, area of impact, centre damage, explosion effect size) in a new botGrenadeBlast object seeded from the weapons.js spec; overrides are keyed on the grenade so the RPG keeps its authored blast, projectile life is stretched past the fuse (life expiry also detonates, so the delay slider died past 2.15s), blast radius now flows from one accessor into the damage ring, the self/friendly veto rings and the evade scan, and FX size scales the puff+light off the damage ring

Grenade panel: live throw-window readout (blast x self-veto vs max range, red when no throw is legal -- a wide blast radius silently forbade every throw) + a Test grenade drop button so the ordnance sliders can be judged on demand instead of waiting on an AI throw decision

Save state-code TSV now POSTs to a new serve.py /api/save-bot-state endpoint so takes land in bot-states/ with no download dialog; browser download stays as the off-server fallback.

Fix: the grenade fuse never decided anything -- update() checked contact before the fuse, so a thrown grenade detonated on its third ground contact (~0.95s measured) and every fuse above the flight time, including the authored 2s one, was unreachable; fuse is now checked first and a new opt-in cooks flag makes contact STOP a grenade (rest on ground / damp off walls) instead of setting it off, with bot-viewer's grenade opting in and the rpg + environment-viewer left on contact detonation; reverted the throw-window readout and Test grenade button added last turn on a wrong hypothesis

Authored rifle run carry (cross-body roll pulled onto the support side, matching the re-tuned walk); decoupled the blend-easing tests from live preset values (synthetic target) and made the frozen-preset regression compare a captured copy, so re-authoring a carry can no longer break unrelated math tests

Authored rifle dash carry: muzzle near-vertical (-1.47) with the weapon dropped to the hip rather than held out at the shoulder, so the barrel clears the head at a sprint (same problem the pistol dash was re-authored for)

Authored pistol walk (thigh low-ready: straight down, no cross-body cant) and re-authored pistol dash; dropped the cross-body-yaw assertion -- it was a rifle-shaped assumption that a pistol carry correctly violates.
